title: Standalone PLOTSETTINGS VisualStyle shade-reference fast slice
mode: primary-source review plus local implementation with generated in-memory controls

sources.finding: The shade-plot enum distinguishes VisualStyle (4) from RenderPreset (5).
VisualStyle and RenderPreset modes require an object ID of the corresponding family; AsDisplayed and Rendered do not use one.
VISUALSTYLE is a standalone DXF object family.

scope: Existing standalone PLOTSETTINGS graph remains DXF-source and R14+ target only
Mode 4 code 333 must target one rooted, owned, identity-consistent VISUALSTYLE
Mode 5 RenderPreset remains rejected pending its complete carrier and writer route
Group 333 uses the existing object-handle remap

method.kind: Focused adapter, graph-preflight, writer/readback, and generated-test implementation
method.limitations: Structural ASCII/Binary round-trip only. No printer/device behavior, semantic plotting, DWG-source standalone page setup, RenderPreset mode, or external CAD acceptance is qualified.

behaviors: PLOTSETTINGS shade mode 4 requires a unique rooted ACAD_VISUALSTYLE dictionary target.
The target must have exactly one typed DRW_VisualStyle and one raw VISUALSTYLE carrier with matching ownership and identity.
The code-333 handle is remapped through the established object handle map.
Other shade mode/reference pairs outside the bounded profile fail before publication.
generatedControls: ASCII and Binary export/readback of a mode-4 page setup whose VISUALSTYLE handle collides with a fixed output handle.
Typed/raw VISUALSTYLE, owner, and remapped code-333 identity checks.
Wrong-family dictionary target and mode-5 RenderPreset rejection.
Existing destination sentinel preservation and same-adapter retry after rejected cases.
